proposition.claim:
Equality in old8pi bound does not require a finite Riemannian cover by a compact round S2xS1 product.

Printed slab endpoints and two repeated epsilon budgets need consistent choices.

Relative homology minimization should be stated via a closed absolute cycle with nonzero relative image; nontriviality typo and empty splitting-time case require clarification.
